result.topic_en: Calculations in linear elasticity expressing displacements u, v, w through a function chi with Lamé constants lambda and mu, deriving relations between Delta^2 chi, boundary quantities p and q, and an auxiliary function chi'.
result.transcription:
$u = (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial x^2} - (\lambda+2\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi$
$v = (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial x\partial y}$
$w = (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial x\partial z}$
$\frac{1}{x}\int N_1\,dx = -\lambda\,\Delta^2\chi + 2(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2} - 2(\lambda+2\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi$
$\frac{1}{x}\int T_3\,dy [-+\frac{1}{x}-] \int T_2\,dz = -(\lambda+3\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi + 2(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}$
$(\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) + (\lambda+3\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi = q$ $\quad x=0,\ q=0$
$(\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) + \lambda\,\Delta^2\chi + 2(\lambda+[-2\mu-]\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi = p$ $\quad x=0,\ \frac{\partial p}{\partial x}=0$
[-p+q=-] $p' - q' = 2(\lambda+\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi' = p+q$
$\Delta^2\chi' = \chi$
$(\lambda+\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi' = (\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) + (2\lambda+3\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi$
$(\lambda+\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi = \lambda+\mu\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi'}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi'}{\partial x^2}\right) + (2\lambda+3\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi'$
$(\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x} - 4\frac{\partial^2\chi'}{\partial x^2}\right) + (\lambda+3\mu)\,\chi = \nabla q$
$\lambda+\mu\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2} - 4\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right)$
$[-\lambda-](\lambda+\mu)\,\chi' = [-\lambda-](\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x} - 4\frac{\partial^2\chi'}{\partial x^2}\right) + [-\lambda-](2\lambda+3\mu)\,\chi + p$
$(\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) - 2\frac{\partial^2 x\,\partial\chi}{\partial x^2} + 8\frac{\partial^4\chi'}{\partial x^4}\right) + (2\lambda+3\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) - 2\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial x^2}$
$(\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi'}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\chi'}{\partial x^2}\right) + (2\lambda+3\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial^2\chi}{\partial x^2}\right) = [-(2\lambda+3\mu)\,\Delta^2\chi'-]\left((\lambda+\mu) - \frac{(2\lambda+3\mu)^2}{\lambda+\mu}\right)\Delta^2\chi$
$= (3\lambda+4\mu)\frac{\lambda+2\mu}{\lambda+\mu}\,\Delta^2\chi$
$2\frac{\partial^2\chi'}{\partial x^2} = x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\chi'}{\partial x} + \frac{\lambda+3\mu}{\lambda+\mu}\,\Delta^2\chi' - \frac{q'}{\lambda+\mu}$
$= x\frac{\frac{\partial(p+q)}{\partial x}}{2(\lambda+\mu)} + \frac{\lambda+3\mu}{2(\lambda+\mu)^2}(p+q) + \frac{q}{\lambda+\mu}$

methods.what: Representation of elastic displacement components through second derivatives of a potential function chi with Lamé constants
Integrated normal stress expressed via chi
Boundary condition equations defining q and p in terms of chi
Introduction of auxiliary function chi' with Laplacian equal to chi, relating p+q
Resulting expression for second x-derivative of chi' in terms of p and q
